local month = "2026-03"
local totals = { NA = 0, EU = 0, APAC = 0 }
local page = 1
local total_pages = 1
local customer_region = {}

repeat
  local r = tool("list_orders", { month = month, page = page })
  total_pages = r.total_pages
  for _, it in ipairs(r.items) do
    local order = tool("get_order", { id = it.id })
    if order.status == "completed" then
      local region = customer_region[it.customer_id]
      if not region then
        local cust = tool("get_customer", { id = it.customer_id })
        region = cust.region
        customer_region[it.customer_id] = region
      end
      totals[region] = totals[region] + order.amount_cents
    end
  end
  page = page + 1
until page > total_pages

return totals
